mcq.q: Which of these is non-decomposable waste?
mcq.explanation: Metal does not rot easily.

mcq.q: Which living things help waste to decompose?
mcq.explanation: Decomposers such as fungi and bacteria break down waste.

mcq.q: Which of these is e-waste?
mcq.explanation: E-waste means old electrical and electronic items.

mcq.q: Which of these is a danger of solid waste?
options: It blocks drains and causes floods
mcq.explanation: Waste blocks drains and water floods the area.

mcq.q: Why are rotting waste heaps a health danger?
options: They attract flies and rats that spread diseases
mcq.explanation: Flies and rats carry germs.

mcq.q: Which disease can spread by mosquitoes breeding in old tins that hold water?
mcq.explanation: Mosquitoes spread malaria and breed in standing water.

mcq.q: Why is polythene dangerous for goats and cows?
options: They may eat it and get sick
mcq.explanation: Animals that eat polythene can become ill or die.

mcq.q: Why is broken glass on the ground dangerous?
options: It can cut people and animals
mcq.explanation: Sharp glass can injure.

mcq.q: Why is burning plastic bad?
mcq.explanation: Burning plastic gives off harmful smoke.

mcq.q: What can leak from old batteries and pollute soil and water?
mcq.explanation: Old batteries have harmful chemicals.

mcq.q: What are the three Rs?
mcq.explanation: Reduce, reuse and recycle are ways of managing waste.

mcq.q: What does reduce mean?
mcq.explanation: To reduce is to make less waste.

mcq.q: What does reuse mean?
mcq.explanation: To reuse is to use again.

mcq.q: What does recycle mean?
mcq.explanation: Recycling makes new things from old materials.

mcq.q: Which is an example of reducing waste?
options: Throwing a bottle in a river
mcq.explanation: A reusable bag means fewer plastic bags are thrown away.

mcq.q: Which is an example of reusing?
options: Using a washed bottle to carry water
mcq.explanation: The bottle is used again for a new purpose.

mcq.q: Which is an example of recycling?
options: Using a tin for a pencil holder
Melting scrap metal to make new items
mcq.explanation: Melting metal to make new items is recycling.

mcq.q: What is a compost pit used for?
mcq.explanation: Decomposable waste rots into compost.

mcq.q: Which waste goes into a compost pit?
mcq.explanation: Only decomposable waste is composted.

mcq.q: What should you wear when collecting waste?
mcq.explanation: Gloves and shoes protect from cuts and germs.

mcq.q: What should you do if you find a needle or broken glass in waste?
options: Pick it up with bare hands
Tell a teacher and do not touch it
mcq.explanation: Sharp objects should be handled by adults using tools.

mcq.q: What should you do after handling waste?
options: Wash hands with soap and clean water
mcq.explanation: Washing removes germs.

mcq.q: Why should waste bins have lids?
options: To keep out flies and rats
mcq.explanation: Covered bins reduce smell and pests.

mcq.q: Which waste can be reused as a pencil holder?
mcq.explanation: A clean tin can be reused.

mcq.q: Which item can be reused as a toy wheel?
mcq.explanation: Bottle tops make good wheels for toys.

mcq.q: Which of these can be made from waste for the classroom?
mcq.explanation: A dustbin can be made from waste materials like a bucket or box.

mcq.q: Which is the best way to manage the food remains from the school kitchen?
options: Put them in a compost pit
mcq.explanation: Kitchen waste can be composted.

mcq.q: At a wedding, what can organisers do to keep the place clean?
options: Provide bins and clean after the event
mcq.explanation: Bins and cleaning keep the place tidy.

mcq.q: Which item is a paper waste that can be recycled?
mcq.explanation: Paper can be turned into new paper.

mcq.q: Which is the best order of managing waste?
mcq.explanation: First make less waste, then reuse, then recycle.

mcq.q: What does the word biodegradable mean?
options: Able to be broken down by living things
mcq.explanation: Biodegradable waste rots naturally.

mcq.q: Why is it good to separate waste into different bins?
options: It makes reusing, recycling and composting easier
mcq.explanation: Sorting helps each type be managed properly.

mcq.q: What is the danger of leaving plastic bags on the ground?
options: They stay for a long time and block drains
mcq.explanation: Plastic bags stay for years and block drains.

mcq.q: Which of these is a tool for picking up waste safely?
mcq.explanation: A rake or shovel keeps hands away from the waste.

mcq.q: Which waste is both decomposable and from an animal?
mcq.explanation: Animal dung rots and can be used as manure.

mcq.q: A wrapper of biscuits is made of plastic. Which type of waste is it?
mcq.explanation: Plastic wrappers do not rot easily.

mcq.q: Which of these is NOT a way of managing solid waste?
mcq.explanation: Throwing waste in rivers pollutes water.

mcq.q: What is a good use of old clothes?
options: Bury them in a garden pit
mcq.explanation: Reusing old cloth as cleaning cloths reduces waste.

mcq.q: What should never be done with waste in a place where children are playing?
mcq.explanation: Burning near children is dangerous.

mcq.q: Why are gumboots useful when handling waste?
options: They protect the feet from sharp things and dirt
mcq.explanation: Boots protect feet from cuts and germs.

mcq.q: In a school, who could check that bins are emptied and clean?
mcq.explanation: Monitors can share the responsibility.

mcq.q: What is the best way to deal with metal scrap in a school?
options: Bury it in the school garden
Sell it to a scrap dealer or reuse it
mcq.explanation: Metal can be recycled.

mcq.q: Which of these makes a good compost mixture?
options: Vegetable peelings, dry leaves and some soil
mcq.explanation: Composting uses natural plant waste.

mcq.q: Why is waste in rivers dangerous?
options: It makes water dirty and harms fish
mcq.explanation: Waste pollutes water and harms living things.

mcq.q: Which of these is a benefit of proper waste management?
mcq.explanation: Proper waste management protects health and the environment.

mcq.q: A pupil wants to make a toy car from waste. Which materials are suitable?
mcq.explanation: A box and bottle tops make a toy car.

mcq.q: What does water conservation mean?
options: Using water carefully and protecting water sources
mcq.explanation: Conservation means saving water and using it wisely.

mcq.q: Which of these is a way of wasting water?
mcq.explanation: A running tap that is not in use wastes water.

mcq.q: Which of these is a source of fresh water?
mcq.explanation: Rivers carry fresh water that people can use.

mcq.q: Why must we conserve water?
mcq.explanation: Only a small part of the world's water is fresh and usable.

mcq.q: A tap leaks 2 litres every hour. How much is wasted in 5 hours?
mcq.explanation: 2 x 5 = 10 litres.

mcq.q: A tap leaks 3 litres each hour. How much is wasted in one day of 24 hours?
mcq.explanation: 3 x 24 = 72 litres.

mcq.q: A leaking pipe wastes 5 litres each day. How much is wasted in 7 days?
mcq.explanation: 5 x 7 = 35 litres.

mcq.q: Which of these is an example of reducing water wastage?
mcq.explanation: Closing taps stops the flow of water.

mcq.q: Which of these uses less water to wash a car?
mcq.explanation: A bucket limits the water used.

mcq.q: What should you do when you see a leaking tap at school?
options: Tell an adult so it can be fixed
mcq.explanation: Reporting leaks helps save water.

mcq.q: Which of these is an example of reusing water?
options: Using water from washing vegetables to water plants
mcq.explanation: Using water twice is reusing.

mcq.q: Which reused water is safe for drinking?
options: None of the used washing water
mcq.explanation: Used washing water is not safe to drink.

mcq.q: What is rainwater harvesting?
mcq.explanation: Harvesting means collecting rainwater from roofs.

mcq.q: Which of these is needed to harvest rainwater from a roof?
mcq.explanation: Gutters carry rain to a tank.

mcq.q: Why should a rainwater tank be covered?
options: To keep out mosquitoes and dirt
mcq.explanation: A cover stops mosquitoes breeding and dirt getting in.

mcq.q: What is the job of the gutter in rainwater harvesting?
options: Carries water from the roof to a pipe
mcq.explanation: Gutters catch water as it runs off the roof.

mcq.q: Which of these describes recycling water?
options: Cleaning used water so it can be used again
mcq.explanation: Recycling cleans water for another use.

mcq.q: Which of these is an example of a place where water may be recycled?
mcq.explanation: Treatment plants clean used water.

mcq.q: Which of these reduces water use when brushing teeth?
mcq.explanation: A cup uses only a little water.

mcq.q: Why is saving water good for families?
mcq.explanation: Less water used means less money paid.

mcq.q: Which of these helps farmers to save water?
mcq.explanation: Drip irrigation gives water directly to roots.

mcq.q: What is mulching?
options: Covering soil with dry grass or leaves
mcq.explanation: Mulch reduces evaporation from the soil.

mcq.q: How does mulching help save water?
options: It reduces evaporation from the soil
mcq.explanation: Covered soil stays moist longer.

mcq.q: When is the best time to water plants?
mcq.explanation: Less water evaporates when it is cooler.

mcq.q: Which of these is a way of protecting water sources?
mcq.explanation: Tree roots hold the soil and protect water.

mcq.q: Why should we not throw waste in rivers?
mcq.explanation: Waste makes water dirty and unsafe.

mcq.q: What does drip irrigation do?
options: Gives water to each plant a drop at a time
mcq.explanation: It gives water slowly at the roots.

mcq.q: Which of these is a reason to conserve water?
options: There will be enough for everyone
mcq.explanation: Conserving leaves water for others.

mcq.q: A school wastes 20 litres a day through leaks. How much in 5 days?
mcq.explanation: 20 x 5 = 100 litres.

mcq.q: A dripping tap fills a 5 litre bucket in one day. How much water is wasted in 4 days?
mcq.explanation: 5 x 4 = 20 litres.

mcq.q: A jerrycan holds 20 litres. A leaking tap wastes 40 litres in a day. How many jerrycans is that?
mcq.explanation: 40 divided by 20 = 2.

mcq.q: Which of these is NOT a way to conserve water?
options: Washing dishes under a running tap
mcq.explanation: A running tap wastes water.

mcq.q: Why do we wash vegetables in a basin?
options: It uses less water and the water can be reused
mcq.explanation: A basin limits water use and allows reuse.

mcq.q: What is a good message for a water conservation poster?
options: Water is free for all to waste
mcq.explanation: A short, clear message helps people remember.

mcq.q: Where should a water conservation poster be put?
options: Near a tap or the school gate
mcq.explanation: Posters should be seen by many people.

mcq.q: Which of these is a source of dirty water we should not drink?
mcq.explanation: Used washing water is dirty and unsafe.

mcq.q: What should be done with stored rainwater before drinking?
mcq.explanation: Boiling or treating kills germs.

mcq.q: Who should monitor taps in a school?
mcq.explanation: Monitors help make sure taps are closed.

mcq.q: Why do we need water for farming?
mcq.explanation: Water is needed for plants and animals.

mcq.q: Which of these is a way to save water when bathing?
mcq.explanation: Using a basin limits the water used.

mcq.q: Why should you keep drinking water in a clean covered container?
options: To keep it safe from germs
mcq.explanation: Covered clean containers protect water.

mcq.q: Which of these is true of water?
options: Water is needed by all living things
mcq.explanation: All living things need water.

mcq.q: Which of these is a result of wasting water?
mcq.explanation: Wasted water is not available to others.

mcq.q: Which of these can make a river dry up?
options: Cutting trees near it and wasting water
mcq.explanation: Cutting trees near sources reduces water.

mcq.q: Why is a bucket better than a running tap for washing a bicycle?
mcq.explanation: A bucket has a limited amount of water.

mcq.q: Who should practise water conservation?
mcq.explanation: Everyone shares water and should save it.

mcq.q: What is a force?
mcq.explanation: A force is a push or a pull.

mcq.q: Which of these is a pull?
options: Opening a drawer by its handle
mcq.explanation: A handle is pulled toward you.

mcq.q: Which of these is a push?
options: Opening a drawer by its handle
mcq.explanation: A kick pushes the ball.

mcq.q: Which force pulls objects down towards the Earth?
mcq.explanation: Gravity pulls things towards the centre of the Earth.

mcq.q: Why does a mango fall from a tree?
mcq.explanation: Gravity acts on every object.

mcq.q: Which force slows down or stops a book sliding on the floor?
mcq.explanation: Friction opposes the movement between surfaces.

mcq.q: Which surface gives the most friction?
mcq.explanation: Rough surfaces give more friction.

mcq.q: Which surface gives the least friction?
mcq.explanation: Oil and smoothness reduce friction.
